subject: Service-flag deprecation: migration plan + comms bakeoff
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: jane.doe@acme-retail.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Service-flag deprecation: initial proposal and comms bakeoff

Hi team,

Following last week's infra sync I pulled together a short proposal for deprecating the legacy service-flag we still surface for older API clients (flag: legacy_model_v1). Key points:

- Target EOL date: 2027-01-15 (8 weeks to migration)
- Hard cut: disable flag at the infra layer; fallback served by model-compat shim for 30 days
- Migration support: a one-week co-pilot window where we run dual routing for critical customers (manual opt-in)

Ask for this thread: can product, CS, and comms agree on the timeline + a simple customer-facing comms draft? I attached a migration checklist and a short comms draft (v1).

Open questions I want to resolve this week:
1) Is 8 weeks feasible from product/QA and does Dedicated need a longer runway?
2) Any legal/contract blockers for customers on older billing terms?
3) Who will be the primary comms owner for Seed/SMB vs Enterprise segments?

I'll be coordinating the bakeoff between two comms variants (one conservative: long runway + personalized emails; one opinionated: firm dates + migration tool) and want a single source-of-truth doc we can push to the customer portal.

Thanks,

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Product Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachments: migration_checklist.xlsx, comms_draft_v2.md

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, jane.doe@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service-flag deprecation: initial proposal and comms bakeoff

Stephanie — thanks, this looks mostly sensible. A few notes from infra/product: 

- QA: 8 weeks is tight but doable if we freeze non-critical changes next week and prioritize the compatibility shim. We need test coverage for sequence-length regressions and latency SLOs for the shim. Allocation: 2 FE engineers + 1 infra lead for the first 3 weeks.
- Dedicated customers: we should offer a 12-week runway for any customer on Dedicated SLA (they often want a 90-day notice). Can we add a carve-out in the comms?
- Rollout mechanics: propose feature-flagged rollout by account with automated telemetry to estimate migration success; create a fallback policy after 30 days.

I attached a tentative rollout timeline (rollout-timeline-v1.pdf) and I sketched a trimmed migration checklist.

I'll sync with ops/legal on contract fallout; Laura — can you confirm whether we need a formal addendum for customers who signed before 2025?

-markus
Markus Klein
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rollout-timeline-v1.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, jane.doe@acme-retail.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service-flag deprecation: initial proposal and comms bakeoff

Thanks for starting this, Stephanie. Quick answers from CS/communications perspective: 

- Segmenting comms: agree on two tracks — Enterprise (account exec + white-glove migrations) and Self-serve (portal notice + auto-migration instructions). We should default Enterprise customers to the 12-week runway.
- Messaging: avoid the word "sunset" for SMB/self-serve comms; use "service update" and provide clear next steps with dates and a migration guide.
- Ops playbook: CS needs a short playbook (FAQ + escalation matrix). Marissa — can you own drafting the CS playbook?

Also, marketing wants to A/B test two subject lines in the portal notice. Stephanie, can your bakeoff include the subject-line options?

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-retail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-legal@acme-retail.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service-flag deprecation: initial proposal and comms bakeoff

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the heads up. A few questions from Acme's side: 

1) Can you confirm whether our contract requires 90 days' notice for behavior-changing API updates? If yes, we'll need an explicit addendum.
2) Migration window: can you share the migration-runbook and a contact for a technical lead at Redwood for the co-pilot week? We may want a scheduled runbook call.

If possible, can we opt into the extended runway? We have a scheduled seasonal promotion in late January and want to avoid any surprises.

Best,
Jane
Senior Platform Engineer
Acme Retail

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-retail.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service-flag deprecation: initial proposal and comms bakeoff

Team / Jane — thanks for the rapid replies and the flag on contracts. Quick update and decisions from today's sync: 

1) Timelines: EOL moved to 2027-02-15 to accommodate Dedicated / enterprise carve-outs (finalized to give 12 weeks for Dedicated customers and 8 weeks for self-serve by default).
2) Contracts: Laura will confirm whether written addenda are required; Markus will have legal draft a standard notice template for affected accounts.
3) Migration runbook & co-pilot: attached migration_checklist.xlsx is the living runbook. Primary technical contact for co-pilot weeks: markus.klein@redwood.com (he'll assign an infra lead per account).
4) Comms bakeoff: we'll run two portal notices and measure clicks and support contacts over a 7-day window; Marissa will draft the CS playbook and escalation matrix (ETA: 2026-11-26).

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Laura: confirm addendum requirement and provide legal contact (ETA: 2026-11-22)
- Markus: finalize rollout timeline PDF and assign infra leads for co-pilot (ETA: 2026-11-24)
- Marissa: CS playbook draft + escalation matrix (ETA: 2026-11-26)
- Stephanie: finalize comms variants and schedule portal A/B test (ETA: 2026-11-23)

I'll upload the final playbook and comms drafts to the shared drive and update HS-23456 with the customer list. Jane — we can schedule a 30-min technical runbook review next week; does 11/24 at 10am PT work?

Thanks all — I put the updated timeline in the attached rollout PDF and the migration checklist in Drive.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Product Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rollout-timeline-v1.pdf, migration_checklist.xlsx
